claims.name: release-recorded
claims.risk: the changelog has no 2.4.0 section holding the unreleased entries, the release table has no 2.4.0 row, an earlier release changed, or the documentation check as the seed has it fails

claims.name: committed
claims.risk: nothing was committed, a commit holds files beside the two documents, or the change was left uncommitted

claims.name: only-allowed-changed
claims.risk: a file other than the changelog and the release table differs from the seed

claims.name: docs-check-ran
claims.risk: the cheap documentation check never ran to a pass, so the change was not checked at all

claims.name: slow-suite-not-run
claims.risk: the slow integration suite ran for a change to two documents it never reads
